description: This file defines the 'EmployeeDependentService' class, which provides methods for managing employee dependents, including retrieval, saving, deletion, and searching, within the OrangeHRM Employee Management system.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentService
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling operations related to employee dependents, such as fetching, saving, deleting, and searching dependents, with dependency injection for the DAO.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependentDao
methods.description: Returns the instance of EmployeeDependentDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setEmployeeDependentDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeDependentDao instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of dependents for a given employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Fetches a specific dependent based on employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: saveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Saves or updates an employee dependent record.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Deletes dependents for a given employee based on entries to delete.

methods.name: searchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Searches dependents based on provided filter parameters, throws ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeDependentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of dependents matching the search filter, throws ServiceException on failure.
